entities.name: Eugène Dubois
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marie Eugène François Thomas Dubois was a Dutch paleoanthropologist and geologist. He earned worldwide fame for his discovery of Pithecanthropus erectus, or "Java Man". Dubois was the first anthropologist to embark upon a purposeful search for hominid fossils.
